basketball.intro: Oklahoma splits its tip-off. Small schools are already playing, and the bigger schools, including McAlester, open in December.
basketball.note: Varsity December schedules are posted by each school on MaxPreps and school athletics sites as they are finalized. The Lady Buffaloes preview, with head coach Kourtnee Beshears, is already up from McAlester Athletics.
basketball.title: Basketball: Season Opening

upcoming.note: Oklahoma's 2A through 6A basketball season starts Dec 1. McAlester plays in 5A, so the Buffaloes and Lady Buffaloes open from this date. Classes A and B started Nov 2 and are already in their season.
upcoming.title: Classes 2A-6A tip off statewide

college.intro: For families who want to watch the top level in person without leaving Oklahoma. Both Oklahoma State and Oklahoma come to Tulsa in December.
college.title: College Wrestling to Watch

upcoming.note: Dec 12-13. Sessions Dec 12 at 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM, and Dec 13 at 10:00 AM and 6:00 PM. Oklahoma State and Oklahoma are both in the field.
upcoming.title: National Duals Invitational

football.intro: Broken Bow is in the Class 4A semifinals after a 51-49 quarterfinal win at Weatherford. McAlester season is in the books.
football.note: McAlester finished 4-6 overall and 3-4 in district play. Scores are from The Oklahoman and MaxPreps, updated Nov 21.
football.path: Playoff path: semifinals Nov 27, Class 4A championship Dec 5 at noon at Chad Richison Stadium, University of Central Oklahoma.

spring.intro: Off-season right now. This panel is ready for spring 2027 schedules, scores, and tournaments.
spring.note: Baseball, fastpitch and slowpitch softball, soccer, track, and golf return in the spring. When a local school or travel team posts a spring schedule or a tournament in Southeast Oklahoma, it will be listed here the same way wrestling is listed, with dates, location, and a link to register or follow along. Coaches and parents: send a spring schedule or tournament flyer to the page now and it will be queued for this panel instead of getting buried in a feed.
